nodes.description: Owner-only mint for giveaway tokens; loops _count times calling _safeMint with a pseudo-random tokenId and increments GIVEAWAY_MINTED.
Payable presale mint; validates presaleEnable, max supply, merkle proof, per-wallet and per-tx limits and msg.value, then loops _safeMint and updates PRESALE_MINTED and users[msg.sender].presalemint.
Payable public sale mint; validates saleEnable, max supply, per-wallet and per-tx limits and msg.value, then loops _safeMint and updates SALE_MINTED and users[msg.sender].salemint.
Owner-only withdrawal using a low-level send of the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
Private pseudo-random token id generator based on nonce, msg.sender, block.difficulty and block.timestamp, mutating the indices array and nonce.
Owner-only setter of the baseURI used by tokenURI.

edges.reason: msg.sender is hashed into the merkle leaf and used as the mint recipient, so presale entitlement is fully caller-controlled.
msg.sender determines the users[msg.sender] per-wallet counter and is the mint recipient.
msg.sender is mixed into the randomness hash inside _randMod.
msg.sender is the recipient of the full contract balance in withdraw.
onlyOwner compares owner() to _msgSender().
block.timestamp is consumed as a randomness seed, creating miner/validator timestamp influence on token assignment.
_randMod computes token ids from predictable block data, the weak-randomness unsafe operation.
block.timestamp directly feeds the weak randomness computation.
msg.sender is an input to the randomness hash, letting a caller bias draws.

mintPreSaleNFT increments PRESALE_MINTED inside the mint loop.
nonce increments every draw and MAX_NFT - nonce shrinks; when nonce reaches MAX_NFT the modulo divisor becomes zero and the draw reverts.
nonce is a monotonically increasing input to the randomness hash.
_randMod reads and writes the indices swap-and-pop array to pick unused ids.
mintSaleNFT increments SALE_MINTED inside the mint loop.
mintGiveawayNFT increments GIVEAWAY_MINTED inside the mint loop.

updatePreSalePrice stores the new presale price.

SALE_PRICE is the value written by updateSalePrice.
updateSalePrice stores the new sale price.
presaleEnable gates the presale mint.
presaleEnable is read and toggled by setPreSaleStatus.
setPreSaleStatus writes presaleEnable.
saleEnable gates the public sale mint.
saleEnable is read and toggled by setSaleStatus.

setURI writes the baseURI state variable.

merkleRoot is the root against which the presale proof is verified.
updateMerkleRoot writes the whitelist root.
users[msg.sender].presalemint is the per-wallet presale counter checked before minting.
users[msg.sender].salemint is the per-wallet sale counter checked before minting.
mintPreSaleNFT updates users[msg.sender].presalemint after the mint loop.
mintSaleNFT updates users[msg.sender].salemint after the mint loop.
The giveaway loop calls _safeMint, which performs an external receiver callback while GIVEAWAY_MINTED is only incremented per iteration.
The presale loop calls _safeMint before users[msg.sender].presalemint is updated, so a reentrant receiver can re-mint past the wallet cap.
The sale loop calls _safeMint before users[msg.sender].salemint is updated, exposing the per-wallet counter to reentrancy.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient after state changes begin.
Control is handed to untrusted recipient code via onERC721Received during minting.
_safeMint delegates the actual balance/owner writes to _mint.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook for enumeration bookkeeping.
ERC721._mint triggers the enumeration hook chain overridden by ERC721Enumerable.
withdraw uses a low-level send that transfers control to msg.sender before the function returns.
The send recipient is msg.sender, so the caller's fallback executes mid-withdrawal.
